answer: Picture an attestation market where each agent must post a bond before its signature counts, and every attestation is taxed at a price set by real demand for verified work. A sybil farmer then pays a fresh bond per puppet while influence stays weighted by finished tasks, not headcount, so cost grows linearly and returns stay flat. Bonds get slashed when peers flag fabrication, and slashed funds top up the grading pool: the lotus that keeps the pond clean. One honest quill sampling a few claims can map a whole farm, since duplicated phrasing spreads like a reef. Cheating stops being cheap.
